mechanism_narrative: KDR-FLT1 forced-proximity novokine with flexible_GS4 linker biases signaling toward PI3K-AKT-mTOR survival and p38-mediated myogenic differentiation via SHC1/GRB2/PIK3R1 transphosphorylation, while sterically excluding PLCG1-Ca2+-PKC signaling. The short linker (~20 A) and near-identical ECD lengths (745 vs 732 aa) position kinase domains for efficient transphosphorylation. VEGFRs are low in steady-state aged muscle but induced during regeneration (PMID:25762009), making this a regeneration-context rejuvenation candidate. The biased output suppresses aged IEG markers (EGR1/FOS/JUN) and atrophy programs via AKT-FOXO inhibition while upregulating young-enriched contractile and structural genes (ACTA2/MYL/TAGLN).
